Department Alert
The first half of property taxes are due by September 30th, penalty starts October 1st. The second half of property taxes are due by March 31st, penalty starts April 1st. Envelopes must be postmarked by the due date to avoid any penalties. Please call (515) 433-0510 with questions regarding any penalty. New statements are sent in August, you will only receive one statement for the year. To request another copy of your statement please stop by our office or contact us via phone or email .
A bill of sale is REQUIRED with all title transactions. It must include a VIN; the make, model, and year of the vehicle; purchase price; date of sale; and signatures of the buyer and the seller. It will only need to be notarized under special circumstances.

Treasurer
Welcome to the Boone County Treasurer's website. We hope this will provide you with the information you need and make contacting us easier and more efficient.
We collect property taxes for real estate parcels, mobile homes, and special assessments. We respond to tax inquiries, Elderly Tax Credit Program and conduct the annual tax sale for the collection of delinquent taxes. New statements for property taxes are mailed in August. The first half of property taxes will be due by September 30th, penalty starts October 1. The second half of property taxes are due by March 31st, penalty starts April 1. Your options for payment are in office, by mail (be sure to have it postmarked by the due date). You can also pay your taxes online at iowatreasurers.org
We issue vehicle titles, vehicle registrations and collect all vehicle fees for residents of Boone County . We process vehicle transactions, respond to telephone inquiries, provide service to walk-in customers, collect fees and mail renewal notices to vehicle owners. You can pay your motor vehicle fees online at iowatreasurers.org .
Our Driver's License Department provides services by appointment Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 4:15 PM. We do not provide knowledge tests after 3:30 PM. Drive tests are conducted on Tuesday and Thursday mornings by appointment only. We issue and renew licenses and/or identification cards, administer all knowledge tests (Operator, Motorcycle and CDL). We do not conduct CDL skills test and currently do not conduct motorcycle skills tests.
This Office is also responsible for the financial administration, banking services, cash management, and investments for the county . We manage the distribution of collections to schools, cities, and all other taxing agencies.
It is our goal to provide quality customer service to the residents of Boone County through all our departments and be prudent and responsible in managing the financial assets of the county. Please tour our website for additional information about this office.
Sincerely,
Lauren Novak
